content.prompt:
Find the smallest value in this stem-and-leaf plot.

$\def\arraystretch{1.4}\begin{array}{r|l}\mathrm{Tens}&\mathrm{Units}\\\hline 47&1\quad 6\quad \phantom{0}\\48&0\quad 3\quad 3\\49&5\quad \phantom{0}\quad \phantom{0}\end{array}$

answer.worked:
The smallest value is in the first row, stem $47$ with leaf $1$.

$$\begin{align*}47\text{ tens}+1\text{ unit}&=471\end{align*}$$
